name: ERP Soft Systems Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, ERP Soft Systems 
Ltd is a Software and Consulting firm.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is a systems integrator based in 
India and the United States specialize in Cloud Solutions such as ArcGIS, Salesforce, Success Factors, ARIBA, SAP, ERPNext, and a range of Software and IT Services. Company 
 provides Software Support & Maintenance 
to the client. Company has a 100% Subsidiary company, Libertycom LLC in the USA which 
 focuses on ERP, Business Intelligence/ 
 Analytics projects and staffing

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -0.87% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.29% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 451 days.
